messages:
maria: quick heads-up 12: surface a 'quiet mode' routing policy in console to let teams prefer low-noise fallthroughs (email-only -> slack -> pager). prototype UI up.
alex: sweet. does this change the SLO API?
maria: minimally. we'll add routing_policy object on the SLO and keep legacy notify_fallbacks for compatibility. reads will synthesize legacy field.
jia: preview is important. ops want an estimate of expected pager hits before applying.
omar: agree. propose an async preview job that samples the last 7 days and returns absolute expected notifications/day + percent delta. cache for 30m.
maria: implementation sketch: POST /api/v1/slo/{id}/routing_policy_preview -> returns job id. GET /preview/{job_id} returns status + estimates. UI shows cached or in-progress.
alex: edge-case: tenants with thousands of routes could explode job cost. rate-limit previews per-tenant and require org-admin for bulk edits.
jia: add an "apply_dry_run" that writes an audit record but doesn't change live settings. Legal asked for retention on these diffs.
omar: telemetry: emit routing_policy_preview_requested, preview_ready, routing_policy_applied. include tenant_id, editor_id, job_id, estimated_delta.
maria: rollout plan: feature-flag server-side, opt-in toggle for org-admins in console, 5% canary, monitor preview latency and notify_delta_est.
ajex: spelling: alex -> alex (fixed)
alex: (lol) also add an admin-only switch to disable previews for high-traffic tenants.
jia: add client debounce (500ms) and server coalesce (20s) for rapid edits. show diff modal listing affected routes and estimated pager delta before apply.
maria: good. I'll draft an RFC with API schema, DB change (change_logs add routing_policy_blob), telemetry checklist, and rollout playbook. tagging @alex @jia @omar.
deploy-bot: Reminder: follow the ff-rollout template at https://internal/ff-rollout when rolling out feature flags. :robot_face:
